references.text: The context of what happened to Adoni-Bezek: the Israelites captured him and cut off his thumbs and big toes
The principle of retribution: a broken bone for a broken bone, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth - the same justice principle that Adoni-Bezek acknowledges
Lex talionis - the law of retribution which Adoni-Bezek himself admits applies to his own actions
God's retribution: as a man sows, so shall he also reap
A psalm stating that God treats people according to their own ways: merciful to the merciful, but to the crooked He shows Himself crooked
Jesus' words that with the measure you use, it will be measured back to you - the same principle of retribution
What a man sows, he shall also reap - God's righteous retribution as Adoni-Bezek experienced
He who leads others into captivity shall himself go into captivity - the same principle of divine retribution
